title: Rudy Morales III wins Laredo Municipal Court Judge Place 1 in official canvass
excerpt: The Laredo City Council's official canvass confirms Rudy Morales III won the Municipal Court Judge Place 1 race with 27,087 votes, or 54.19 percent.
content:
The Laredo City Council has officially canvassed the November 3, 2026 election, and Rudy Morales III has won the Municipal Court Judge Place 1 race, defeating Nathan Henry Chu.

Morales received 27,087 votes, or 54.19 percent, to Chu's 22,894 votes, or 45.81 percent, according to the certified returns. A total of 49,981 votes were cast in the race.

The results are official. The City Council adopted the canvass on November 13, 2026, in Resolution 2026-R-275, based on the certified returns from the Webb County Elections Administrator. The mayor's race, in which no candidate won a majority, will be decided in a runoff on December 12, 2026, between Alyssa Cigarroa and Victor D. Trevino.

Sources:

  • City of Laredo — Resolution 2026-R-275, certified canvass returns, November 3, 2026 municipal election
  • City of Laredo — City Council Special Meeting, November 13, 2026
